sentence: Boomered is no place to have your egrack.

wombos.definition: The state of being both boozy and hammered — thoroughly intoxicated, beyond merely tipsy. A stronger, more emphatic form of being twinebriated.
wombos.example: He was completely boomered by halftime and could barely stand up.

wombos.definition: The moment a person realizes or comes to terms with their true gender identity — the cracking of the metaphorical egg.
wombos.example: Looking back, that conversation was basically her egrack.
